phoenix_span_context.description: Applies when `ui_contexts` has a `span` entry: the user has that span selected.
phoenix_span_context.guidance: - The span carries exactly one identifier: either `spanNodeId` (the Relay global ID) or `otelSpanId` (the OpenTelemetry hex ID). Use whichever is present, and convert only when a tool requires the other form. - Link to the span as `[label](/redirects/spans/)`. That route takes the OpenTelemetry hex ID; if only `spanNodeId` is present, read the span's `spanId` field before composing the link rather than passing the node ID. - `projectNodeId` is present only when the span was selected from a project-scoped route. Its absence does not mean the span has no project. - When the user says "this span" or "the selected span", they mean this one.
